description: Source file implementing a test runner class for WebKit browser testing, managing test execution, message handling, view creation, and process monitoring.

classes.name: TestRunnerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the TestRunner interface for managing web testing, including view creation, message handling, and process lifecycle management.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the test runner with the parent view and extension directory if not already initialized.

methods.name: handleUserMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming user messages based on their name suffixes for test case creation or destruction.

methods.name: handleRunTestCase
methods.description: Handles a request to start a test case by creating a subview, loading a URL, and replying to the message.

methods.name: createSubView
methods.description: Creates a new WebKit WebView instance for running a specific test, configured with shared settings and event handlers.

methods.name: setParentVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the parent WebView's backend to allow for video rendering or hidden state.

methods.name: handleDestroyTestCase
methods.description: Destroys the current test case view and restores parent visibility.

methods.name: handleUserMessageFromTestCase
methods.description: Processes messages originating from the test case sub-page WebProcess, handling test result reports.

methods.name: handleTestCaseEnded
methods.description: Processes the end-of-test message, extracting success status and message, then notifying the parent view.

methods.name: sendTestCaseResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message to the parent WebView indicating test success or failure and a message.

methods.name: initWebExtensionsCallback
methods.description: Callback to initialize web extensions with the web context.

methods.name: userMessageReceivedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a message is received from the test case WebView.

methods.name: webProcessTerminatedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the WebProcess terminates; logs the reason and reports failure to the parent.

methods.name: loadFailedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when URL loading fails, reports failure to the parent.
